### Observed differences

- In the later window, activity A02 participates in fewer traces: it appears in about 15 in 100 traces (30 of 200) versus about 26 in 100 (53 of 200) in the earlier window. [OCC001]
- Its mean occurrences per trace fell from 0.295 to 0.16 (a drop of about 0.135), and repetition within a trace also became rarer, from about 3 in 100 traces to about 1 in 100. [OCC001]
- This difference is unusual for a random split: it is larger than in about 995 of 1,000 reference re-splits of the pooled traces. [OCC001]

### Inference

Support level: Insufficient evidence
The evidence is insufficient to infer a structural change in the process. Only one item qualified across 87 tested units, where about 0.43 items would qualify by chance alone if nothing had changed, so even a single striking item such as A02's lower participation (about 15 in 100 traces versus about 26 in 100) is what a stable process typically produces, and sampling variation between two 200-trace windows — including a rare variant appearing in one window — cannot be ruled out. [OCC001]
